reference_sql: SELECT d0, round(m0, 2) FROM (WITH b0 AS (SELECT 1 AS "k0", "BRCH_DIM_1"."BRCH_DIVSN_CD" AS "d0", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN TRAN_FACT_1.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'O' THEN -TRAN_FACT_1.TRAN_AM ELSE TRAN_FACT_1.TRAN_AM END) END AS "value" FROM TRAN_FACT_1 JOIN MONTH_DIM_1 ON TRAN_FACT_1.MNTH_END_DT = MONTH_DIM_1.CLDR_EOM_DT JOIN ACCT_DIM2_1 ON TRAN_FACT_1.DW_ACCT_ID = ACCT_DIM2_1.DW_ACCT_ID AND TRAN_FACT_1.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID = ACCT_DIM2_1.SRCE_SYS_ID AND ACCT_DIM2_1.CURR_IN <> 0 JOIN BRCH_DIM_1 ON ACCT_DIM2_1.ACCT_DOMCL_BRCH_CD = BRCH_DIM_1.BRCH_CD AND BRCH_DIM_1.CURR_IN <> 0 WHERE TRAN_FACT_1.CURR_IN <> 0 AND (TRAN_FACT_1.NNA_IN = 'Y' AND TRAN_FACT_1.RCV_IN = 1) AND MONTH_DIM_1.DW_BRKRG_MNTH_FRM_TODAY_CT <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ACCT_DIM2_1 WHERE ACCT_DIM2_1.DW_ACCT_ID = TRAN_FACT_1.DW_ACCT_ID AND ACCT_DIM2_1.SRCE_SYS_ID = TRAN_FACT_1.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID AND ACCT_DIM2_1.TEST_ACCT_IN = 'Y') AND ("TRAN_FACT_1"."DW_TRAN_DT" >= CAST('2024-07-01' AS DATE) AND "TRAN_FACT_1"."DW_TRAN_DT" < CAST('2024-10-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY "BRCH_DIM_1"."BRCH_DIVSN_CD"), spine AS (SELECT "k0", "d0" FROM b0), aligned AS (SELECT "s"."k0", "s"."d0", CASE WHEN "b0"."k0" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE "b0"."value" END AS "x0", CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "b0"."k0" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE "b0"."value" END IS NULL THEN 'missing_observation' ELSE NULL END AS "z0" FROM spine AS s LEFT JOIN b0 ON "s"."k0" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "b0"."k0" AND "s"."d0" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "b0"."d0") SELECT "d0" AS "d0", "x0" AS "m0", "z0" AS "m0/reason" FROM aligned ORDER BY "d0") recorded
